Bring artificial intelligence to space.
Description

Emxys from Elche begins the design and manufacturing of a satellite to bring artificial intelligence to space in 2025.

It will allow transporting high-performance computational applications to detect fires, volcanic eruptions or hurricane formation before a human analyst.

The project, called EdgeAISat, has been selected within the Strategic Cooperation Projects program of the Valencian Innovation Agency (AVI) and has the participation of the UMH and the UPV. Will develop an evolution of its satellite platform Odaliss to implement AI in space.
